Tactical pause

Pause when you need time to plan your orders.

Orders can be given while paused. In co-op, shared pause and speed depend on the host settings.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Game speed

Set your desired game speed using the highlighted panel in the lower-right corner of the screen. The panel has a marker indicating your current game speed. The panel also indicates how long you've been playing.

You can choose one of three modes: "normal" speed, "accelerated" speed and "pause". Accelerated speed mode makes all characters (both yours and enemies) move quicker. Normal is, of course, the standard setting. With "pause" you can interrupt the game for a while to think about what's going on.

You can also set the game speed via the keyboard:
Accelerated speed: <+> key.
Normal speed: <-> key.
Pause: <SPACE> bar.

Pause mode

"Pause" mode can be very useful in, for example, tight combat situations. In this mode, game time stops. You can still control the camera and issue orders to characters, but they will be carried out only after you cancel the "pause" mode. You should use this mode to assess enemies' strength, determine your targets or choose spells.

To switch "pause" mode on or off, just use the <SPACE> bar.
